# Spec: Open and preview a template

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/preview-a-template.md)

**Start:** `/content/templates`  
**Persona:** A developer working with text templates  
**Goal:** Open a template file, change its text and see it rendered with sample data without saving anything.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Open a template file | The source box holds the template text. |
| 2 | Preview the draft | The output shows the rendered text. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `preview-a-template`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
